opinions: I SUPPORT CONDUCTING RESEARCH ON AN INTERNATIONAL SCALE BECAUSE HUMANITY BENEFITS MOST WHEN KNOWLEDGE AND INNOVATION ARE SHARED ACROSS BORDERS.
I SUPPORT SINGLE-PAYER UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE BECAUSE ENSURING EVERY PERSON HAS ACCESS TO ESSENTIAL MEDICAL CARE ALIGNS WITH TREATING HUMAN DIGNITY AND WELL-BEING AS FUNDAMENTAL.
BASIC UTILITIES LIKE ROADS AND ELECTRICITY SHOULD BE PUBLICLY OWNED BECAUSE NATURAL MONOPOLIES THAT EVERYONE DEPENDS ON SHOULD SERVE THE PUBLIC INTEREST RATHER THAN PRIVATE PROFIT.
TRADITIONS HAVE VALUE ONLY INSOFAR AS THEY PROMOTE HUMAN FLOURISHING; ON THEIR OWN THEY HOLD NO INTRINSIC WORTH AND SHOULD BE DISCARDED WHEN THEY CAUSE HARM.
IF WE ACCEPT MIGRANTS IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THEY ASSIMILATE INTO OUR CULTURE BECAUSE SUCCESSFUL SOCIETIES REQUIRE A SHARED FOUNDATION OF VALUES, LANGUAGE, AND NORMS.
CHILDREN SHOULD BE EDUCATED IN CRITICAL THINKING, EVIDENCE, AND ETHICAL REASONING RATHER THAN RELIGIOUS OR TRADITIONAL VALUES THAT MAY CONFLICT WITH REALITY OR INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS.
PROSTITUTION SHOULD NOT BE ILLEGAL BECAUSE CONSENTING ADULTS HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE CHOICES ABOUT THEIR OWN BODIES, THOUGH REGULATION IS NEEDED TO PREVENT EXPLOITATION.
THOSE WITH A GREATER ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD NOT RECEIVE BETTER HEALTHCARE BECAUSE A PERSON'S WEALTH SHOULD NOT DETERMINE THEIR ACCESS TO LIFE-SAVING TREATMENT.
IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN WORTHWHILE TRADITIONS OF OUR PAST WHILE CRITICALLY EXAMINING AND REFORMING THOSE THAT ARE UNJUST OR NO LONGER SERVE HUMAN PROGRESS.
MAINTAINING HEALTHY FAMILY STRUCTURES AND VALUES IS ESSENTIAL BECAUSE STRONG FAMILIES FORM THE FOUNDATION OF STABLE AND FLOURISHING SOCIETIES.
IT IS BETTER TO ENSURE WELFARE FOR ALL CITIZENS THAN TO FETISHIZE A BALANCED BUDGET, BECAUSE HUMAN SUFFERING SHOULD TAKE MORAL PRIORITY OVER FISCAL TARGETS.
REASON IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN MAINTAINING OUR CULTURE BECAUSE CULTURE SHOULD SERVE HUMAN REASON AND WELL-BEING, NOT THE OTHER WAY AROUND.
STRONG LEADERSHIP IS GOOD ONLY WHEN IT IS CONSTRAINED BY ROBUST INSTITUTIONS AND DEMOCRATIC ACCOUNTABILITY; UNCHECKED STRONG LEADERSHIP TENDS TOWARD TYRANNY.
SOCIAL PROGRAMS SHOULD NOT BE ABOLISHED IN FAVOR OF PRIVATE CHARITY BECAUSE CHARITY IS TOO UNRELIABLE AND INSUFFICIENT TO GUARANTEE BASIC DIGNITY AND SECURITY FOR ALL.
IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE WORK AS A UNITED WORLD TO COMBAT CLIMATE CHANGE BECAUSE THIS IS A PLANETARY CRISIS THAT NO SINGLE NATION CAN SOLVE ALONE.
INHERITANCE IS A LEGITIMATE FORM OF WEALTH TRANSFER BUT LARGE INHERITANCES SHOULD FACE SIGNIFICANT TAXATION TO PREVENT THE ENTRENCHMENT OF UNEARNED DYNASTIC POWER.
SAME-SEX MARRIAGE SHOULD BE LEGAL BECAUSE THE STATE HAS NO BUSINESS PREVENTING CONSENTING ADULTS FROM FORMING RECOGNIZED FAMILY BONDS.
ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ARE ESSENTIAL BECAUSE MARKETS ALONE FAIL TO PROTECT THE COMMONS AND FUTURE GENERATIONS FROM DESTRUCTIVE EXTERNALITIES.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL BECAUSE BODILY AUTONOMY IS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT AND NO PERSON SHOULD BE FORCED TO GESTATE AGAINST THEIR WILL.
IT IS VERY IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN LAW AND ORDER BUT IT MUST BE PAIRED WITH JUSTICE; ORDER WITHOUT JUSTICE IS OPPRESSION.
MILITARY ACTION BY OUR NATION SHOULD BE RARE, STRICTLY DEFENSIVE, AND BASED ON CLEAR MORAL JUSTIFICATION RATHER THAN FREQUENT OR PREEMPTIVE.
NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY REMAINS IMPORTANT BUT MUST BE BALANCED WITH INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION ON EXISTENTIAL THREATS LIKE CLIMATE CHANGE AND PANDEMICS.
WE SHOULD ACCEPT SUBSTANTIAL IMMIGRATION WHILE MAINTAINING REASONABLE CONTROLS AND EMPHASIZING SUCCESSFUL INTEGRATION, BECAUSE OPENNESS TO TALENT AND PEOPLE ENRICHES SOCIETIES.
MY RELIGIOUS VALUES, OR ANYONE'S, SHOULD NOT BE SPREAD THROUGH STATE POWER BECAUSE FREEDOM OF CONSCIENCE REQUIRES THAT GOVERNMENT REMAIN NEUTRAL ON RELIGION.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND SUBJECTED TO SCRUTINY BECAUSE POWER TENDS TO CORRUPT AND UNCHECKED AUTHORITY BECOMES DANGEROUS.
IT IS WRONG TO FURTHER MY GROUP'S GOALS ABOVE ALL OTHERS BECAUSE JUSTICE IS UNIVERSAL AND TRIBALISM UNDERMINES THE COMMON GOOD.
GENETIC MODIFICATION CAN BE A FORCE FOR GOOD IF STRICTLY REGULATED AND AIMED AT PREVENTING SUFFERING, BUT MODIFYING HUMANS RAISES PROFOUND ETHICAL CONCERNS THAT REQUIRE EXTREME CAUTION.
GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD BE HEAVILY REGULATED WITH STRICT LICENSING, TRAINING REQUIREMENTS, AND PROHIBITIONS ON CERTAIN CLASSES OF WEAPONS BECAUSE PUBLIC SAFETY OUTWEIGHS UNRESTRICTED INDIVIDUAL ACCESS.
A HIERARCHICAL STATE IS NOT BEST; WHILE SOME HIERARCHY IS INEVITABLE, FLATTER, MORE ACCOUNTABLE STRUCTURES BETTER PROTECT LIBERTY AND PREVENT ABUSE OF POWER.
QUALITY EDUCATION IS A RIGHT OF ALL PEOPLE BECAUSE IT IS A PREREQUISITE FOR MEANINGFUL EQUALITY OF OPPORTUNITY AND INFORMED CITIZENSHIP.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO CORRECT MARKET FAILURES, PROTECT CONSUMERS, AND PROVIDE PUBLIC GOODS THAT MARKETS WILL NOT SUPPLY ADEQUATELY.

FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEEDS REPRESENTS AN ASPIRATIONAL MORAL PRINCIPLE, THOUGH IN PRACTICE IT REQUIRES CAREFUL INSTITUTIONAL DESIGN TO AVOID AUTHORITARIAN OUTCOMES.
DEMOCRACY IS MORE THAN A DECISION-MAKING PROCESS; IT EMBODIES VALUES OF EQUALITY, DIGNITY, AND THE RIGHT OF INDIVIDUALS TO HAVE A MEANINGFUL SAY IN THEIR GOVERNANCE.
INTERNATIONAL AID IS NOT A WASTE OF MONEY WHEN EFFECTIVELY TARGETED, AS REDUCING EXTREME POVERTY AND DISEASE SERVES BOTH MORAL AND STRATEGIC INTERESTS.
THE GENERAL POPULACE CAN MAKE POOR DECISIONS ESPECIALLY WHEN POORLY INFORMED, WHICH IS WHY STRONG INDEPENDENT INSTITUTIONS, EDUCATION, AND CONSTITUTIONAL LIMITS ON MAJORITIES ARE ESSENTIAL.
STRATEGIC TARIFFS CAN SOMETIMES BE JUSTIFIED TO PROTECT VITAL INDUSTRIES OR COUNTER UNFAIR PRACTICES, BUT BROAD PROTECTIONISM USUALLY HARMS OVERALL PROSPERITY.
RELIGION SHOULD NOT PLAY A FORMAL ROLE IN GOVERNMENT BECAUSE PLURALISTIC SOCIETIES REQUIRE SECULAR GOVERNANCE TO PROTECT FREEDOM OF BELIEF.
ALL PEOPLE SHOULD BE TREATED EQUALLY REGARDLESS OF CULTURE, SEXUALITY, RACE, OR OTHER IRRELEVANT CHARACTERISTICS BECAUSE EQUAL MORAL WORTH IS FUNDAMENTAL.
WARS MUST BE JUSTIFIED BOTH MORALLY AND LEGALLY TO THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY BECAUSE NO NATION IS ABOVE BASIC STANDARDS OF JUSTICE.
TO CHASE PROGRESS AT ALL COSTS IS DANGEROUS BECAUSE SOME FORMS OF PROGRESS CAN DESTROY IRREPLACEABLE HUMAN GOODS, SOCIAL COHESION, OR THE ENVIRONMENT.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL WHEN PRACTICED RESPONSIBLY AND CONSENSUALLY BETWEEN ADULTS.
A UNITED WORLD GOVERNMENT WOULD LIKELY CONCENTRATE TOO MUCH POWER AND RISK TYRANNY; BETTER TO PURSUE ROBUST INTERNATIONAL INSTITUTIONS WHILE PRESERVING ACCOUNTABLE NATION-STATES.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE ACCOUNTABLE TO THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY ON ISSUES LIKE GENOCIDE, HUMAN RIGHTS ATROCITIES, AND EXISTENTIAL RISKS.
PHYSICIAN-ASSISTED SUICIDE SHOULD BE LEGAL WITH STRICT SAFEGUARDS BECAUSE INDIVIDUALS FACING TERMINAL SUFFERING DESERVE DIGNITY AND AUTONOMY IN THEIR FINAL CHOICES.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT GOVERNMENT FOLLOWS THE MAJORITY OPINION WHEN IT IS WRONG; CONSTITUTIONAL PROTECTIONS AND MORAL PRINCIPLES MUST SOMETIMES OVERRIDE TRANSIENT MAJORITIES.
MY NATION HAS GREAT QUALITIES AND ACHIEVEMENTS BUT ALSO SERIOUS FLAWS; BLIND PATRIOTISM IS DANGEROUS WHILE MEASURED PRIDE COMBINED WITH SELF-CRITICISM IS HEALTHY.
THE SACRIFICE OF SOME CIVIL LIBERTIES IS NOT A PRICE WORTH PAYING FOR PROTECTION FROM TERRORISM BECAUSE ERODED LIBERTIES ARE RARELY RESTORED AND OFTEN EXPAND BEYOND THEIR ORIGINAL JUSTIFICATION.
OUR NATION'S VALUES SHOULD BE SPREAD PRIMARILY BY EXAMPLE AND PERSUASION RATHER THAN COERCION OR MILITARY FORCE.
IT IS MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN PEACEFUL RELATIONS THAN TO FURTHER OUR STRENGTH WHEN STRENGTH IS DEFINED IN PURELY MILITARISTIC OR ZERO-SUM TERMS.
THE FREER THE MARKETS THE FREER THE PEOPLE IS A HALF-TRUTH; MARKETS CAN ALSO GENERATE NEW FORMS OF DOMINATION AND REQUIRE RULES AND REDISTRIBUTION TO TRULY SERVE LIBERTY.
CHURCHES SHOULD BE TAXED THE SAME WAY OTHER INSTITUTIONS ARE TAXED WHEN THEY ENGAGE IN NON-RELIGIOUS COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY BECAUSE RELIGIOUS STATUS SHOULD NOT CONFER SPECIAL ECONOMIC PRIVILEGE.
NOT ALL CULTURES ARE EQUAL; SOME VALUES AND PRACTICES ARE OBJECTIVELY BETTER FOR HUMAN FLOURISHING THAN OTHERS, EVEN WHILE RESPECTING BASIC RIGHTS.
THE UNITED NATIONS SHOULD NOT BE ABOLISHED BUT SHOULD BE SUBSTANTIALLY REFORMED BECAUSE A FLAWED INTERNATIONAL FORUM IS BETTER THAN NONE.
MILITARY SPENDING IS OFTEN EXCESSIVE AND SHOULD BE REDUCED IN FAVOR OF DIPLOMACY, DEVELOPMENT, AND ADDRESSING REAL SECURITY THREATS MORE INTELLIGENTLY.
I SUPPORT WELL-DESIGNED REGIONAL UNIONS LIKE THE EU BECAUSE THEY CAN PROMOTE PEACE, PROSPERITY, AND COOPERATION ACROSS BORDERS WHILE PRESERVING DEMOCRATIC ACCOUNTABILITY.
CLIMATE CHANGE IS CURRENTLY ONE OF THE GREATEST THREATS TO OUR WAY OF LIFE AND REQUIRES URGENT, LARGE-SCALE COLLECTIVE ACTION.
THE STATE IS NOT INHERENTLY A THREAT TO LIBERTY; A PROPERLY CONSTRAINED DEMOCRATIC STATE IS ONE OF THE BEST TOOLS FOR PROTECTING LIBERTY AGAINST PRIVATE POWER.
REGARDLESS OF POLITICAL OPINIONS IT IS NOT ALWAYS RIGHT TO SIDE WITH YOUR COUNTRY WHEN YOUR COUNTRY IS COMMITTING SERIOUS MORAL WRONGS.
IT IS NECESSARY FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO INTERVENE IN THE ECONOMY TO PROTECT CONSUMERS FROM FRAUD, MONOPOLY, AND DANGEROUS EXTERNALITIES.
OPPRESSION BY GOVERNMENTS REMAINS A GREATER SYSTEMIC THREAT THAN OPPRESSION BY CORPORATIONS, THOUGH BOTH MUST BE GUARDED AGAINST.
THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION SHOULD NOT BELONG EXCLUSIVELY TO WORKERS; COMPLEX MODERN ECONOMIES REQUIRE A MIX OF OWNERSHIP FORMS INCLUDING PRIVATE CAPITAL, COOPERATIVES, AND PUBLIC OPTIONS.
MOST DRUG USE SHOULD BE DECRIMINALIZED OR LEGALIZED WITH REGULATION BECAUSE PROHIBITION CAUSES MORE HARM THAN THE DRUGS THEMSELVES IN MANY CASES.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT THEIR OWN CITIZENS THAN FOREIGNERS WHILE STILL RECOGNIZING BASIC MORAL OBLIGATIONS TO NON-CITIZENS.
SOCIETY WAS NOT BETTER MANY YEARS AGO; DESPITE REAL LOSSES, MOST PEOPLE TODAY ENJOY GREATER RIGHTS, HEALTH, PROSPERITY, AND OPPORTUNITY THAN IN PREVIOUS CENTURIES.
TAXES SHOULD BE INCREASED ON THE RICH TO PROVIDE FOR THE POOR AND FUND PUBLIC GOODS BECAUSE EXTREME INEQUALITY UNDERMINES BOTH FAIRNESS AND SOCIAL STABILITY.
EVEN WHEN PROTESTING AN AUTHORITARIAN GOVERNMENT, VIOLENCE SHOULD GENERALLY BE AVOIDED BECAUSE IT OFTEN LEGITIMIZES GREATER REPRESSION AND UNDERMINES MORAL LEGITIMACY.
GOVERNMENT SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE STRICTLY LIMITED, TARGETED, AND SUBJECT TO ROBUST OVERSIGHT BECAUSE MASS SURVEILLANCE ERODES THE FOUNDATIONS OF A FREE SOCIETY.
IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE THINK IN THE LONG TERM BEYOND OUR LIFESPANS BECAUSE WE HAVE MORAL OBLIGATIONS TO FUTURE GENERATIONS AND THE HEALTH OF CIVILIZATION.
A BETTER WORLD WILL COME FROM RESPONSIBLE AUTOMATION, SCIENCE, AND TECHNOLOGY GUIDED BY WISDOM AND ETHICAL VALUES RATHER THAN PURSUED BLINDLY.
PUBLICLY-FUNDED RESEARCH IS OFTEN MORE BENEFICIAL TO THE PEOPLE THAN PURELY MARKET-DRIVEN RESEARCH BECAUSE IT CAN TARGET LONG-TERM BASIC SCIENCE AND PUBLIC GOODS THAT MARKETS NEGLECT.
